text: Theresa Aba Kufuor (née Mensah; 25 October 1935 – 1 October 2023) was the wife of John Kufuor, the second President of the Fourth Republic of Ghana, and served as First Lady of Ghana from 2001 to 2009. She was a nurse and midwife. Born Theresa Mensah on 25 October 1935, she was the youngest child in her family, with her older brother being Joseph Henry Mensah, an economist and New Patriotic Party politician. She began her education at the Catholic Convent, OLA, in Keta, Volta Region, Ghana, and later studied in London, where she became a Registered General Nurse at the Southern Hospital Group of Nursing in Edinburgh, Scotland. She further trained at the Radcliffe Infirmary in Oxford and Paddington General Hospital in London, qualifying as a State Certified Midwife with a Certificate in Premature Nursing. Theresa married John Kufuor when he was 23 after meeting him at a Republic Day Anniversary Dance in London in 1961; they married in 1962. Together, they had five children: J. Addo Kufuor, Nana Ama Gyamfi, Saah Kufuor, Agyekum Kufuor, and Owusu Afriyie Kufuor. She was a mother of five and a grandmother of eight, and a devout Roman Catholic. Despite serving as First Lady for eight years between 2001 and 2009, she maintained a low political profile. In 2007, she advocated for policy changes in the Government's white paper on Educational Reforms to implement UNESCO's Free Compulsory Universal Basic Education (FCUBE) program for kindergarten children. John Kufuor founded the Mother and Child Community Development Foundation (MCCDF), a non-governmental organization operating in Ghana and Canada that supports work in preventing mother-to-child transmission. Theresa Kufuor died at her home in Peduase on 1 October 2023, at the age of 87. Her funeral took place on November 16 at Accra's State House, featuring hymns and tributes, followed by the transportation of her remains to Kumasi for a three-day funeral at Heroes Park, culminating in her burial in the Ashanti Regional capital. On 25 October 2010, Pope Benedict XVI awarded her husband, President John Kufuor, the Papal Award of Knight Commander of St. Gregory the Great for his service to mankind and the Catholic Church, and conferred on Theresa Kufuor the Papal Award Dame of St. Gregory the Great for her commitment to the plight of poor children and their mothers.
